subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “A stone from a road may be ignored.”?
options: At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.
A simple picture can make people stop and think.
Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.
A stone from another world can make people look up.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「At night, even familiar things can make people ask new questions.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A simple picture can make people stop and think.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「Problems are easier to fix when people look closely.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「A stone from a road may be ignored. A stone from another world can make people look up.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「A stone from a road may be ignored. A stone from another world can make people look up.」，答案為「A stone from another world can make people look up.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「A stone from another world can make people look up.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
